
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/Johny-zhao/p/23115756" title="发布于 2026-09-24 21:12">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">华三VXLAN集中式网关实战指南：Spine多活网关 + 双活接入（M-LAG）</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p><strong>一、方案架构与拓扑设计</strong></p>
<p><strong>1.1 设计思路</strong></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">本方案采用</span>Spine-Leaf两层架构，Spine层双机部署作为集中式VXLAN IP网关，Leaf层双机通过M-LAG实现双活接入。该架构的核心优势在于：</p>
<ul>
<li>· <strong><span style="font-family: 等线">集中式网关部署在</span>Spine设备上</strong><span style="font-family: 等线">，所有三层流量均经过</span>Spine设备处理，便于流量控制和策略部署</li>
<li>· <strong>Leaf层M-LAG双活接入</strong><span style="font-family: 等线">，两台物理设备虚拟成一台逻辑设备作为</span>VTEP，避免单点故障</li>
<li>· <strong>Spine多活网关</strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：两台</span>Spine通过BGP EVPN建立对等关系，实现网关冗余和负载分担</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>1.2 逻辑拓扑</strong></p>
<p>text</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">┌─────────────────────────────────────┐</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">│ &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;外部网络 (Internet/WAN) &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;│</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">└──────────┬──────────┬───────────────┘</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">│ &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;│</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">┌──────────┴──┐ &nbsp;┌───┴──────────┐</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">│ &nbsp;Spine-1 &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;│ &nbsp;│ &nbsp;&nbsp;Spine-2 &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;│</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">│ (集中式网关) │ &nbsp;│ &nbsp;(集中式网关) │</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">│ &nbsp;&nbsp;VTEP &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;│ &nbsp;│ &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;VTEP &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;│</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">└──┬───┬───┬──┘ &nbsp;└──┬───┬───┬───┘</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">│ &nbsp;&nbsp;│ &nbsp;&nbsp;│ &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;│ &nbsp;&nbsp;│ &nbsp;&nbsp;│</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">┌────────┘ &nbsp;&nbsp;│ &nbsp;&nbsp;└────────┘ &nbsp;&nbsp;│ &nbsp;&nbsp;└────────┐</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">│ &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;│ &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;│ &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;│</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">│ &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;┌───────┴───────┐ ┌──────┴────────┐ &nbsp;&nbsp;│</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">│ &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;│ &nbsp;&nbsp;Leaf-1 &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;│ │ &nbsp;&nbsp;Leaf-2 &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;│ &nbsp;&nbsp;│</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">│ &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;│ &nbsp;&nbsp;VTEP &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;│ │ &nbsp;&nbsp;VTEP &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;│ &nbsp;&nbsp;│</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">│ &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;│ &nbsp;(M-LAG成员) &nbsp;│ │ &nbsp;(M-LAG成员) &nbsp;&nbsp;│ &nbsp;&nbsp;│</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">│ &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;└───────┬───────┘ └──────┬─────────┘ &nbsp;&nbsp;│</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">│ &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;│ &nbsp;&nbsp;peer-link &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;│ &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;│</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">│ &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;└────────────────┘ &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;│</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">│ &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;│ &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;│</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">│ &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;┌───────┴───────┐ &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;│</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">└────────────┤ &nbsp;Server/Eth-Trunk (M-LAG) &nbsp;&nbsp;│</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">└────────────────────────────┘</span></p>

<p><strong>注意</strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：当</span>VXLAN集中式网关场景下Spine上行链路故障时，用户侧流量可能无法转发而被丢弃，需通过monitor-link或路由联动机制解决。</p>
<p><strong>二、各设备配置范例</strong></p>
<p><strong>2.1 Underlay网络配置（以OSPF为例）</strong></p>
<p><strong>Spine-1 Underlay配置：</strong></p>
<p>text</p>
<p>system-view</p>
<p>sysname Spine-1</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p># 配置Loopback0作为VTEP源地址</p>
<p>interface LoopBack0</p>
<p>&nbsp;ip address 1.1.1.1 32</p>
<p>&nbsp;quit</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p># 配置与Leaf-1互联接口</p>
<p>interface Ten-GigabitEthernet 1/0/1</p>
<p>&nbsp;port link-mode route</p>
<p>&nbsp;ip address 10.0.1.1 30</p>
<p>&nbsp;quit</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p># 配置与Leaf-2互联接口</p>
<p>interface Ten-GigabitEthernet 1/0/2</p>
<p>&nbsp;port link-mode route</p>
<p>&nbsp;ip address 10.0.2.1 30</p>
<p>&nbsp;quit</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p># 配置OSPF实现三层互通</p>
<p>ospf 1 router-id 1.1.1.1</p>
<p>&nbsp;area 0.0.0.0</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;network 1.1.1.1 0.0.0.0</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;network 10.0.1.0 0.0.0.3</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;network 10.0.2.0 0.0.0.3</p>
<p>&nbsp;quit</p>
<p>&nbsp;quit</p>
<p><strong>Spine-2 Underlay配置：</strong> <span style="font-family: 等线">类似配置，</span>Loopback0为2.2.2.2/32，互联地址对应调整。</p>
<p><strong>Leaf-1 Underlay配置：</strong></p>
<p>text</p>
<p>system-view</p>
<p>sysname Leaf-1</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>interface LoopBack0</p>
<p>&nbsp;ip address 2.2.2.1 32</p>
<p>&nbsp;quit</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>interface Ten-GigabitEthernet 1/0/1</p>
<p>&nbsp;port link-mode route</p>
<p>&nbsp;ip address 10.0.1.2 30</p>
<p>&nbsp;quit</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>interface Ten-GigabitEthernet 1/0/2</p>
<p>&nbsp;port link-mode route</p>
<p>&nbsp;ip address 10.0.3.1 30</p>
<p>&nbsp;quit</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>ospf 1 router-id 2.2.2.1</p>
<p>&nbsp;area 0.0.0.0</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;network 2.2.2.1 0.0.0.0</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;network 10.0.1.0 0.0.0.3</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;network 10.0.3.0 0.0.0.3</p>
<p>&nbsp;quit</p>
<p>&nbsp;quit</p>
<p><strong>Leaf-2 Underlay配置：</strong> <span style="font-family: 等线">类似配置，</span>Loopback0为2.2.2.2/32。</p>
<p><strong>2.2 Spine集中式网关配置（BGP EVPN方式）</strong></p>
<p><strong>Spine-1配置：</strong></p>
<p>text</p>
<p># 1. 全局使能L2VPN和VXLAN</p>
<p>l2vpn enable</p>
<p>vxlan tunnel mac-learning disable</p>
<p>vxlan tunnel arp-learning disable</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p># 2. 配置VXLAN硬件资源模式（三层网关模式）</p>
<p>hardware-resource vxlan l3gw24k</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p># 3. 配置BGP EVPN</p>
<p>bgp 65001</p>
<p>&nbsp;peer 2.2.2.1 as-number 65002</p>
<p>&nbsp;peer 2.2.2.1 connect-interface LoopBack0</p>
<p>&nbsp;peer 2.2.2.2 as-number 65002</p>
<p>&nbsp;peer 2.2.2.2 connect-interface LoopBack0</p>
<p>&nbsp;#</p>
<p>&nbsp;address-family l2vpn evpn</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;peer 2.2.2.1 enable</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;peer 2.2.2.2 enable</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;undo policy vpn-target</p>
<p>&nbsp;quit</p>
<p>&nbsp;quit</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p># 4. 配置VSI（VXLAN实例）</p>
<p>vsi vxlan10</p>
<p>&nbsp;vxlan 5010</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;tunnel 2.2.2.1</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;tunnel 2.2.2.2</p>
<p>&nbsp;quit</p>
<p>&nbsp;quit</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p># 5. 配置VXLAN IP网关（集中式网关核心）</p>
<p>interface Vsi-interface 10</p>
<p>&nbsp;ip address 10.1.1.1 24</p>
<p>&nbsp;l3-vni 5010</p>
<p>&nbsp;quit</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p># 6. 配置BD与VSI关联</p>
<p>vlan 10</p>
<p>&nbsp;quit</p>
<p>interface Vsi-interface 10</p>
<p>&nbsp;quit</p>
<p><strong>Spine-2配置：</strong> <span style="font-family: 等线">与</span>Spine-1类似，主要区别为Loopback0地址（1.1.1.2）和BGP Router ID。两台Spine通过EVPN对等体实现网关路由同步。</p>
<p><strong>2.3 Leaf M-LAG双活接入配置</strong></p>
<p><strong>Leaf-1 M-LAG配置：</strong></p>
<p>text</p>
<p># 1. 配置M-LAG系统参数</p>
<p>m-lag system-mac 0000-0000-0001</p>
<p>m-lag system-number 1</p>
<p>m-lag system-priority 150</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p># 2. 配置peer-link（建议使用聚合口）</p>
<p>interface Bridge-Aggregation 1</p>
<p>&nbsp;port link-type trunk</p>
<p>&nbsp;port trunk permit vlan all</p>
<p>&nbsp;link-aggregation mode dynamic</p>
<p>&nbsp;quit</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>interface Ten-GigabitEthernet 1/0/10</p>
<p>&nbsp;port link-aggregation group 1</p>
<p>&nbsp;quit</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>interface Ten-GigabitEthernet 1/0/11</p>
<p>&nbsp;port link-aggregation group 1</p>
<p>&nbsp;quit</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p># 3. 配置DFS Group关联VXLAN</p>
<p>m-lag mad exclude interface Vlan-interface 4094</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p># 4. 配置用户侧M-LAG接口</p>
<p>interface Bridge-Aggregation 10</p>
<p>&nbsp;port link-type trunk</p>
<p>&nbsp;port trunk permit vlan 10</p>
<p>&nbsp;link-aggregation mode dynamic</p>
<p>&nbsp;m-lag 1</p>
<p>&nbsp;quit</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>interface Ten-GigabitEthernet 1/0/20</p>
<p>&nbsp;port link-aggregation group 10</p>
<p>&nbsp;quit</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p># 5. 配置VXLAN</p>
<p>l2vpn enable</p>
<p>vsi vxlan10</p>
<p>&nbsp;vxlan 5010</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;tunnel 1.1.1.1</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;tunnel 1.1.1.2</p>
<p>&nbsp;quit</p>
<p>&nbsp;quit</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p># 6. 将M-LAG接口关联到VSI</p>
<p>interface Bridge-Aggregation 10</p>
<p>&nbsp;quit</p>
<p><strong>Leaf-2 M-LAG配置：</strong> <span style="font-family: 等线">与</span>Leaf-1类似，主要区别：m-lag system-number 2。</p>
<p><strong>关键说明</strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：两台</span>Leaf的M-LAG接口对应的VBDIF接口需要具有相同的IP地址和MAC地址。如需防止上行链路故障时流量丢弃，可配置monitor-link关联上行接口和下行接口，当上行出口DOWN时下行接口状态也变为DOWN。</p>
<p><strong>2.</strong><strong>4</strong><strong> <span style="font-family: 等线">服务器侧配置（</span>Linux Bonding示例）</strong></p>
<p># /etc/sysconfig/network-scripts/ifcfg-bond0</p>
<p>DEVICE=bond0</p>
<p>TYPE=Bond</p>
<p>BONDING_MASTER=yes</p>
<p>BOOTPROTO=static</p>
<p>IPADDR=10.1.1.100</p>
<p>NETMASK=255.255.255.0</p>
<p>GATEWAY=10.1.1.1 &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# 指向Spine双活网关</p>
<p>BONDING_OPTS="mode=802.3ad miimon=100 lacp_rate=1"</p>
<p>#</p>
<p># /etc/sysconfig/network-scripts/ifcfg-eth0</p>
<p>DEVICE=eth0</p>
<p>TYPE=Ethernet</p>
<p>BOOTPROTO=none</p>
<p>MASTER=bond0</p>
<p>SLAVE=yes</p>
<p>#</p>
<p># /etc/sysconfig/network-scripts/ifcfg-eth1</p>
<p>DEVICE=eth1</p>
<p>TYPE=Ethernet</p>
<p>BOOTPROTO=none</p>
<p>MASTER=bond0</p>
<p>SLAVE=yes</p>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">三、</span>M-LAG流量转发机制</strong></p>
<p><strong>3.1 正常转发路径</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>· <strong><span style="font-family: 等线">跨</span>VNI流量</strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：</span>VM → Leaf（M-LAG双活）→ Spine（集中式网关）→ 三层转发 → 目标VNI → 目标Leaf → 目标VM</li>
<li>· <strong>VXLAN访问外部</strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：</span>VM → Leaf → Spine（集中式网关）→ 外部网络</li>
<li>· <strong><span style="font-family: 等线">对称</span>IRB转发</strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：入口和出口网关均执行三层路由转发，外层</span>IP头源IP为入口VTEP地址，目的IP为出口VTEP地址</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>3.2 故障切换场景</strong></p>
<table border="0" cellspacing="0">
<tbody>
<tr>
<td valign="center">
<p>故障场景</p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p>切换机制</p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p>收敛时间</p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td valign="center">
<p>Leaf-1上行链路故障</p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p>M-LAG将流量切换到Leaf-2的VXLAN隧道</p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p>&lt; 1s</p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td valign="center">
<p>Leaf-1整机故障</p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p>M-LAG peer-link同步，流量全部切换到Leaf-2</p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p>&lt; 1s</p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td valign="center">
<p>Spine-1故障</p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p>BGP EVPN路由撤销，Spine-2接管网关</p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">取决于</span>BGP收敛</p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td valign="center">
<p>Spine上行链路故障</p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">利用</span>M-LAG机制将流量切换到对端VXLAN隧道</p>
</td>
<td valign="center">
<p>需配合联动机制</p>
</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p><strong>注意</strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：当</span>Spine VXLAN隧道故障时，需确保M-LAG双活网关配置正确且对端VXLAN隧道状态为UP，否则需通过BGP EVPN同步隧道状态信息，触发流量重新路由。</p>
<p><strong>四、网络调试详细步骤</strong></p>
<p><strong>4.1 基础连通性检查</strong></p>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">步骤</span>1：检查Underlay三层可达性</strong></p>
<p>text</p>
<p># 在Spine-1上ping Leaf-1的Loopback0</p>
<p>ping -a 1.1.1.1 2.2.2.1</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p># 检查OSPF邻居状态</p>
<p>display ospf peer</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p># 检查IP接口状态</p>
<p>display ip interface brief</p>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">步骤</span>2：检查VXLAN隧道状态</strong></p>
<p>text</p>
<p># 查看VXLAN隧道信息（关键命令）</p>
<p>display l2vpn vsi verbose</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p># 查看隧道接口详细状态</p>
<p>display interface Tunnel 1</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p># 检查隧道源/目的地址</p>
<p>display vxlan tunnel</p>
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">正常输出应显示隧道状态为</span>Up，Tunnel source和destination地址正确。</p>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">步骤</span>3：检查VSI与VXLAN ID绑定</strong></p>
<p>text</p>
<p># 查看VSI状态和VXLAN ID</p>
<p>display l2vpn vsi name vxlan10 verbose</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p># 验证VNI与BD映射</p>
<p>display vxlan vni</p>
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">需确认两端</span>VSI名称不同但VXLAN ID相同（正确配置），且同一VTEP上不同VSI未使用相同VXLAN ID。</p>
<p><strong>4.2 BGP EVPN检查</strong></p>
<p>text</p>
<p># 检查BGP EVPN对等体状态</p>
<p>display bgp peer l2vpn evpn</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p># 查看接收到的EVPN路由</p>
<p>display bgp l2vpn evpn</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p># 查看IMET路由（用于头端复制）</p>
<p>display evpn auto-discovery imet</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p># 查看MAC/IP路由</p>
<p>display evpn auto-discovery mac-ip</p>
<p><strong>4.3 ARP抑制配置与检查</strong></p>
<p>text</p>
<p># 在Spine集中式网关上开启ARP泛洪抑制</p>
<p>vsi vxlan10</p>
<p>&nbsp;arp suppression enable</p>
<p>&nbsp;quit</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p># 查看ARP抑制表项</p>
<p>display arp suppression vsi vxlan10</p>
<p>ARP泛洪抑制功能可有效避免ARP请求报文占用核心网络带宽，VTEP从本地或VXLAN隧道接收ARP报文后建立抑制表项。</p>
<p><strong>4.4 常见故障排查流程</strong></p>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">故障</span>1：VXLAN隧道Down</strong></p>
<p>排查步骤：</p>
<p>1. display ip interface brief → 确认源IP正确</p>
<p>2. display ospf peer → 确认底层路由可达</p>
<p>3. ping -a [源VTEP] [目的VTEP] → 验证底层IP连通性</p>
<p>4. <span style="font-family: 等线">检查</span>UDP端口号是否一致（display current-configuration | include vxlan udp-port）</p>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">故障</span>2：隧道UP但业务不通</strong></p>
<p>排查步骤：</p>
<p>1. <span style="font-family: 等线">确认两端</span>VNI一致：display vxlan vni</p>
<p>2. <span style="font-family: 等线">检查</span>AC服务实例匹配：display l2vpn vsi name vxlan10 verbose</p>
<p>3. <span style="font-family: 等线">确认泛洪抑制未误配：检查</span>flooding disable all命令</p>
<p>4. <span style="font-family: 等线">检查</span>MAC地址表学习：display mac-address vsi vxlan10</p>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">故障</span>3：集中式网关Ping不通</strong></p>
<p>排查流程：</p>
<p>1. <span style="font-family: 等线">检查</span>VXLAN隧道是否为UP → 若DOWN则修改隧道和路由配置</p>
<p>2. <span style="font-family: 等线">检查</span>VXLAN IP网关接口状态 → 若DOWN则修改网关接口配置</p>
<p>3. <span style="font-family: 等线">检查是否存在网关</span>IP对应的ARP表项 → 若不存在则修改ARP相关配置</p>
<p><strong>4.5 硬件资源模式检查</strong></p>
<p>text</p>
<p># 查看VXLAN硬件资源模式</p>
<p>display hardware-resource vxlan</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p># 如果模式不正确，重新配置（需重启生效）</p>
<p>hardware-resource vxlan l3gw24k</p>
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">对报文进行三层转发的</span>VXLAN IP网关设备上，需要配置VXLAN硬件资源模式为l3gw模式。多台设备形成IRF堆叠时，VXLAN硬件资源模式必须保持一致。</p>
<p><strong>五、注意事项</strong></p>
<p><strong>5.1 硬件资源模式</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>· Spine设备作为集中式网关，必须配置三层网关模式：hardware-resource vxlan l3gw24k</li>
<li>· Leaf设备作为VTEP（二层网关），配置二层网关模式即可</li>
<li>· 修改硬件资源模式后需要<strong>重启设备</strong>才能生效</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>5.2 IRF堆叠注意事项</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>· <span style="font-family: 等线">如果</span>Leaf层采用IRF堆叠而非M-LAG，堆叠前需确保各成员设备的VXLAN硬件资源模式一致</li>
<li>· IRF Domain ID通常默认为0，需要根据网络规划手动配置</li>
<li>· <span style="font-family: 等线">堆叠设备间建议配置</span>BFD MAD检测，MAD检测接口需关闭STP协议</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>5.3 M-LAG部署关键点</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>· <strong>peer-link建议使用聚合口</strong><span style="font-family: 等线">，避免单链路故障导致</span>M-LAG协商异常</li>
<li>· M-LAG接口下建议配置基于源/目的IP+端口的哈希算法，增加负载分担粒度</li>
<li>· M-LAG主备设备需要同时作为三层网关，必须保证M-LAG成员接口对应的VBDIF接口具有相同的IP和MAC地址</li>
<li>· <span style="font-family: 等线">密切关注</span>peer-link状态，若出现拥塞或协商异常，M-LAG双活机制可能退化</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>5.4 集中式网关部署注意</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>· <span style="font-family: 等线">集中式网关场景下所有三层流量经</span>Spine处理，<strong>Spine设备压力较大</strong>，不适合大规模网络</li>
<li>· <span style="font-family: 等线">建议在</span>Spine上部署ARP泛洪抑制，减少广播报文对核心网络的影响</li>
<li>· <strong>注意</strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：</span>FE、FX类型单板用作集中式VXLAN IP网关时，不能同时用作接入本地站点的VTEP设备</li>
<li>· <span style="font-family: 等线">交换机工作模式必须设置为</span>standard模式</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>5.5 隧道与路由注意</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>· <span style="font-family: 等线">确保两端设备</span>UDP端口号一致（默认4789）</li>
<li>· Loopback口需发布32位路由，确保VTEP源地址可达</li>
<li>· BGP EVPN需正确配置RT（Route Target）以控制路由的发布与接收</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>5.</strong><strong>6</strong><strong>常见翻车点</strong></p>
<p>1. Peer-Link未放行业务VLAN：Peer-Link必须port trunk permit vlan all或至少包含所有业务VLAN，否则M-LAG裂开时业务中断。</p>
<p>2. <span style="font-family: 等线">忘记配置</span>link-aggregation mode dynamic：M-LAG成员口和Peer-Link都必须使用动态LACP模式，静态聚合无法协商M-LAG状态。</p>
<p>3. Keepalive链路不通：Keepalive建议使用独立三层链路或带外管理网，若ping不通会导致M-LAG状态异常。</p>
<p>4. M-LAG裂开后Secondary设备接口Error-Down：裂开后Secondary设备所有非排除接口会被置为Error-Down，默认300秒恢复，可通过m-lag restore-delay调整。</p>
<p>5. <span style="font-family: 等线">单台设备重启后角色为</span>None：当只有一台设备在线时，需配置m-lag auto-recovery reload-delay加速恢复。</p>
<p>6. <span style="font-family: 等线">一致性检查导致配置失败：生产环境建议开启一致性检查，但调试时可临时关闭</span>m-lag consistency-check disable。</p>
<p>7. <span style="font-family: 等线">服务器</span>ARP学习问题：双活网关场景下，服务器可能只从一个网卡发ARP，导致另一台Spine学不到ARP。可在Leaf配置arp smart-discover enable主动探测。</p>
<p><strong>六、验证与测试</strong></p>

<p><strong>6.2 业务测试步骤</strong></p>
<p>1. <strong><span style="font-family: 等线">同</span>VNI二层互通测试</strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：同一</span>Leaf下不同VM互ping</p>
<p>2. <strong><span style="font-family: 等线">跨</span>VNI三层互通测试</strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：不同</span>VNI的VM经过Spine网关互ping</p>
<p>3. <strong>VXLAN访问外部测试</strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：</span>VM ping外部网络地址（如8.8.8.8）</p>
<p>4. <strong>M-LAG切换测试</strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：断开</span>Leaf-1上行链路，验证流量自动切换到Leaf-2</p>
<p>5. <strong>Spine网关切换测试</strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：断开</span>Spine-1，验证Spine-2接管网关功能</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
